review_comments: In `generic.py` class `NDFrame` is grandchild/child of the `DirNamesMixin`. And in class `NDFrame` and `DataFrame`, `_accessors` is a `set`, so mypy will throw an error if I leave it to be a `frozenset` here. See this PR #25909 . More specifically start reading from here https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/25909#issuecomment-477592965
